title: Qsyn A Developer-Friendly Quantum Circuit Synthesis Framework for NISQ Era and Beyond

predicted_errors.error_location: Table I (COMPARISON WITH PYZX ON THE GATE-LEVEL SYNTHESIS STAGE)
predicted_errors.supporting_evidence: The paper references 'Table I' and makes specific quantitative claims about it (e.g., that PyZX encounters TLE/MLE on circuits such as gf2^128, hwb12, and urf4, and that Qsyn achieves smaller or equal RZ-counts and shallower circuits), but the actual table with numerical data is missing from the paper body. A reviewer cannot verify these specific claims because the supporting data is not presented, despite the text treating the table's content as established fact.

The text states 'Qsyn achieved either smaller or equal RZ-counts and, on average, shallower circuits... attributed to Qsyn's integration of ZX-calculus and Tableau combined methods, further compressing rotation counts.' This causal/comparative conclusion is asserted without any visible supporting data (the referenced Table I is not shown in the text), making the claim unsupported by the evidence presented in the paper.

The claim 'adopt a more compact ZX-diagram representation for MCT gates and an early-stopping strategy to avoid producing redundant graph complexity [11]' cites reference [11] to justify a technique described as Qsyn's own revision/improvement over the original algorithm, but it is unclear from the text whether [11] is the source of this technique or merely tangentially related work, creating ambiguity about proper attribution of the contribution.
